summary: Xewkija Heliport (GZM/LMMG) is the main heliport serving the island of Gozo, Malta's smaller northern island. Located in the town of Xewkija, it provides quick helicopter transfers connecting Gozo to Malta International Airport and other destinations. The heliport is notable for its proximity to the impressive Rotunda of Xewkija, one of the largest unsupported domes in the world.
faqs:
Q: How long is the helicopter flight from Xewkija Heliport to Malta?
A: The helicopter flight to Malta International Airport typically takes around 10-15 minutes, offering a scenic aerial view of the Gozo Channel.

Q: Which airlines operate from Xewkija Heliport?
A: Harbert's Air and a few other operators have historically provided scheduled helicopter services between Gozo and Malta, though schedules and operators may vary by season.

Q: Is Xewkija Heliport the only heliport in Gozo?
A: It is the primary heliport on Gozo and the main one used for scheduled passenger transfers, though there are other small heliports on the Maltese islands.

Q: Can I walk to Xewkija town center from the heliport?
A: Yes, the heliport is located very close to Xewkija town center, and the famous Rotunda church is within walking distance.
transport_tips: Taxis and local buses are available near the heliport for onward travel around Gozo. Car rental agencies are also nearby if you plan to explore the island independently. Renting a quad bike or jeep is a popular option for navigating Gozo's rural roads and scenic coastal areas.
local_tip: If you have time before or after your flight, walk a few minutes to the Rotunda of Xewkija (also called the Church of St. John the Baptist) — climb to the observation deck for panoramic views over Gozo, a unique experience most helicopter travelers miss.
